question: How long did Nike keep its own name printed inside its main logo?
answer: About 24 years. From 1971 the curve travelled with the word Nike beside or across it; in 1995 the company judged the mark recognisable alone and dropped the wordmark from its primary logo. The shape was only lightly refined over the years: the stroke a student sketched in 1971 now carries the name by itself.
move: A name can be dropped only after years of paying to attach it.
source: Nike, company history of the Swoosh
